Message:
wifi: rtl8xxxu: mark Edimax EW-7811Un V2 as tested

The Edimax V2 (vid 0x7392, pid 0xb811) works well with the rtl8xxxu driver
since rtl8188eu support has been added. Remove the untested flag for this
device.
